Subject: MAP kickoff + SOC 2 evidence owners & data handling POC

Hi Claire + Evan —

Thanks for the quick heads-up call yesterday. As discussed, attaching a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) and a blank SOC 2 evidence template so we can align owners and timelines. High-level ask from us: get the SOC 2 evidence owners and the data handling point of contact (POC) confirmed this week so we can slot evidence drops into the MAP.

Who we’ve looped in from Redwood: Marcus (technical lead, will coordinate evidence ingestion), Lauren (who owns the MAP timeline and exec updates), and Soojin (GRC lead for any compliance questions).

Immediate next steps:
- Claire/Evan: confirm which of your folks will own each evidence category (policies, access reviews, encryption docs, incident response) — one name per bucket please.
- Marcus: will share S3 dropbox details and a short checklist for file formats.
- Lauren: can we target a first evidence collection by Aug 20 and a GAP review the week of Aug 24?

Attachments: redwood_map_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), soc2_evidence_template.pdf (evidence checklist), data_flow_diagram.png (from onboarding call)

If helpful I can schedule a 30-min sync for Monday to walk through the MAP.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Head of Trust & Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Claire Wong <claire@horizon-analytics.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Tray <evan.tray@horizon-analytics.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-09T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + SOC 2 evidence owners & data handling POC

Thanks Mina — appreciate the doc. Quick responses below:

- Evidence owners: I will be the program lead but assigning owners as follows:
  - Policies & Procedures: Nora Patel (nora.patel@horizon-analytics.com)
  - Access Reviews & IAM: Evan Tray (evan.tray@horizon-analytics.com)
  - Encryption & Key Management: Samir Rao (samir.rao@horizon-analytics.com)
  - Incident Response: Claire Wong (me) — will provide tabletop notes and IR plan

- Data handling POC: Evan Tray (cc’d) is our security operations lead and will be primary POC for any data residency/retention questions.
- Aug 20 evidence drop is tight but doable; can prioritize Policies and Access Reviews for that date.

Evan — can you confirm S3 access method (IAM role vs pre-signed URLs) and whether we can push zipped evidence into the bucket by Aug 20?

Happy to take the 30-min Monday sync if that helps — Tuesday morning our time works better (Aug 10, 9–11am PDT).

Best,
Claire
Security Program Manager
Horizon Analytics

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Claire Wong <claire@horizon-analytics.com>, Evan Tray <evan.tray@horizon-analytics.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + SOC 2 evidence owners & data handling POC

Claire/Evan —

Thanks for the quick owner list — that's perfect. Quick technical notes on the S3 evidence dropbox:

- We prefer you create an internal zip per evidence category and upload to the bucket at s3://horizon-evidence-dropbox/rdw-rd-087/ (we will provide temporary cross-account role access).
- I'll send a separate email with the IAM role ARN and a short how-to for uploading by end of day.
- File naming convention: <EvidenceCategory>_<YYYYMMDD>_<OwnerInitials>.zip (helps automation).
- For encryption: we support client-side encryption or server-side KMS (aws:kms). If you use KMS, please provide the CMK alias so we can configure access policies.

Also attaching a one-page checklist (included in the MAP workbook) to help Horizon map the template fields to the files you upload.

Marcus Lin
Principal Systems Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + SOC 2 evidence owners & data handling POC

Thanks everyone — solid momentum here. Quick coordination items and confirmed timeline: 

- Confirmed evidence milestones: Aug 20 (Policies + Access Reviews), Sep 3 (Encryption + Configs), Sep 17 (IR + Ops runbooks).
- I'll add these to the MAP spreadsheet and set up automated reminders to both teams.
- Mina: please add me as the escalation contact for exec updates; I will prepare a short weekly summary for Horizon and our sales lead.
- Claire: can you confirm whether Horizon requires redaction (PII removal) on any of the evidence artifacts before upload? If so we will create a redaction checklist.

Proposed standing check-in: 30 minutes, Tue mornings 9:00am PDT starting Aug 17. Claire, you mentioned Tue mornings work — if that’s still true I’ll send a recurring invite and include a short agenda (status, blockers, next 7 days).

Thanks — looking forward to first evidence drop.

Lauren Bishop
Sr. Manager, Customer Success & Onboarding
Redwood Inference
